exact_missing_items: blocked_owner is absent from the blocked projection record, making it impossible to determine which system component is responsible for unblocking an attempt
storage-plan.md and Contracts_V0.md must add blocked_owner (the identity of the component/role that caused the block) to the blocked projection record
blocked_sequence should be owned by the runtime scheduler/executor layer, not by UI/HITL/chat/storage
blocked_sequence scope: monotonic per {run_id, node_id}, starts at 1, increments only when node transitions from non-blocked to a new blocked episode
Make Executor_Protocol.md + Contracts_V0.md the joint owners of blocked_sequence minting semantics, blocked-episode lifecycle, and startup-recovery scheduler handshake
Recast HITL request contracts so request_id is explicitly subordinate to blocked-episode identity
canonical contracts have requested_account_policy but not an equally canonical requested_account_id
several downstream docs therefore cannot represent a user-selected concrete account on the requested side without collapsing it into policy text

chain-wizard-flexibility.md still leaves wizard normalized payloads too thin to satisfy adjacent contracts that already require thread_id, project_id, and validation lineage for reproducible pre-run quality governance

Extend wizard/interview handoff payloads so they can carry the upstream subset of canonical runtime identity: project_id, thread_id, wizard_id, requested/effective persona, platform, model, account, execution_role, operational_identity?, permission/runtime snapshot refs
Add an explicit lineage bridge from wizard/interview artifacts and handoff payloads into the eventual execution run: likely wizard_id -> run_id
Treat interview-phase tier_id-style coordination keys as legacy/local labels only; do not let them become canonical ownership or routing keys
concern projection / concern_counts / node_concerns[] fields are missing from Run_Graph_View.md and from the candidate runtime projection contracts in Contracts_V0.md
blocked-owner vs concern-owner distinction must be added to the node-state model so UI can render correct triage options
concern records must be queryable from Run Graph node-click context

human-in-the-loop.md now exposes a sharper self-contradiction: it deprecates allowed_actions[] in favor of allowed_action_ids[], but Contracts_V0.md and storage-plan.md still publish allowed_actions in HITL-adjacent canonical shapes
Reconcile all approval/recovery schemas onto one key strategy and one field family (allowed_action_ids[], blocked_sequence, explicit mapping for any retained request_id)
storage-plan.md still registers HITL events as request_id, run_id, tier_id, tier_type, request_kind, message, allowed_actions, which is now behind the newer blocked-projection/action-family model
manual_preferred_account_id (set by user in settings) is distinct from requested_account_id (set per-run by the caller/dispatcher)
manual_preferred_account_id is a persistent user preference that provides a default requested account for runs that do not specify one
requested_account_id takes precedence over manual_preferred_account_id when both are present
This distinction must be clearly defined in Multi-Account.md and in the account-identity resolution chain
memory.gist.* event family is used in assistant-memory-subsystem.md but has no canonical owner in Contracts_V0.md and no storage registration in storage-plan.md
AutoMilestone trigger semantics are described in the memory subsystem but have no event contract or durable storage anchor
project-switch handoff does not have a canonical transition sequence or event contract
operational_identity block must be present in all runtime snapshots: run.started events, attempt records, receipt records, usage events, concern records, and attention items
The block must be a stable named inline object (not spread fields) so it can be referenced by name in storage and consumption contracts
Fields: effective_account_id, effective_runtime_id, effective_persona_key, execution_role, actor_kind, requested_account_binding, pressure_flags, degradation_flags
project_attention_item.v1:{project_id}:{attention_item_id} must be a dedicated redb projection key
project_attention_item family is absent from storage-plan.md

projection must carry canonical shape defined in the attention center cluster analysis: attention_item_id, project_id, severity, owner_kind, reason_code, source_kind, source_object_ref, primary_route_payload, secondary_route_payloads[], display_title, display_subtitle, disclosure_visibility
canonical_replacement_hints: request_id (lookup metadata only, not canonical recovery target)
canonical runtime identity in handoff payload
